test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hesitant
solution:
The correct answer is **Reluctant.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given option is** **Reluctant.
 
• The word **hesitant** means **tentative, unsure, or slow in acting or speaking.**
 
• The word similar words are Reluctant, **uncertain, dubious etc.**
 
• Thus the correct synonym is** ****Reluctant.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The antonym of the Hesitant word is **certain, decisive, confident **etc.
